system.description:
You infuse chakra into the ink as you then infuse a chakra seal into it. You conjure a clone of yourself made of ink. They look, sound and act as you describe. The cost of these clones cannot be reduced below half.

An Ink clone has 1 Hit point and can be no farther than 90 feet from you. It can walk, talk and interact with things but it cannot declare an attack. This clone acts at the end of your turn. As a bonus action you can command the clone to attack. When you do it pretends to weave hand seals to cast a jutsu targeting a single creature within 60 feet of it.

The target creature makes a Wisdom (Insight) Check vs your Ninjutsu Save DC. On a failure, they become distracted by the clones antics. A creature distracted in this manner grants the next attack targeting it advantage and they are treated as surprised against this attack.
